description: Three voltage inputs and a grid of outputs carrying their sums, products, differences, quotients and averages

inputs.text: One of the three voltages every output is calculated from

outputs.text: The sum of a and b
The sum of a and c
The sum of b and c
a multiplied by b
a multiplied by c
b multiplied by c
a subtracted from b
a subtracted from c
b subtracted from a
b subtracted from c
c subtracted from a
c subtracted from b
b divided by a; it reads 0V whenever c is at 0V, because the module tests the wrong input before dividing
c divided by a; while a is at 0V it holds the last value it reached rather than falling to 0V
a divided by b; it reads 0V while b is at 0V
c divided by b; while b is at 0V it holds the last value it reached rather than falling to 0V
a divided by c; while c is at 0V it holds the last value it reached rather than falling to 0V
b divided by c; it reads 0V while c is at 0V
The average of a and b
The average of b and c
The average of a and c
The average of all three inputs
